LESSON: WRITING 5.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING - PLAYS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How does a play differ from a story?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the features of a play for information
2. write a short play based on the theme for communication
3. recognise the contribution of playwriting in the preservation of culture

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 5.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING - PLAYS
This lesson teaches Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays for Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain the features of a play for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write a short play based on the theme for communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. recognise the contribution of playwriting in the preservation of culture
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays above.
2. Explain Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 5.3.1 Creative Writing - Plays important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does a play differ from a story?
2. How are plays written?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the features of a play for information
2. write a short play based on the theme for communication
3. recognise the contribution of playwriting in the preservation of culture

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
